visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a wide shot of a baseball stadium field under a bright, partly cloudy sky. A man in a navy blue Brothers baseball jersey (number 92) and cap stands in the distance on the green grass, throwing a ball. The stadium's white and gray stands are visible in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a medium close-up of the man, identified by his jersey as Yueh Cheng-Hua. He has a short haircut and wears a gold cross necklace. He looks directly toward the camera, smiling slightly while catching his breath. Yellow variety captions appear above and below him. (3) The shot shifts to a medium-long perspective from behind a padded fence. The man (number 92) is standing on the dirt path near the dugout, talking and handling a baseball in his glove. Another man in a black helmet and jersey (number 90) stands with his back to the camera in the foreground. (4) From a lower angle behind the dugout fence, we see the man in jersey 92 throw the ball again. The man in jersey 90, Chan Tzu-Hsien, turns around and walks up the dugout steps towards the camera. He wipes his mouth/nose with his hand, exhibiting a skeptical facial expression while variety captions explain his reaction.
